videos.script: A chat with a model is a list of messages, and each one has a role. {{roles}} The user writes. The assistant answers. And above both sits a third role, the system. {{system}} The system message holds the standing instructions: what the assistant is for, how it speaks, what it refuses. {{standing}} It is sent again with every request, at the top of the conversation. {{every}} Models are trained to give it weight, and that training is all the authority it has. A user can still argue with it, and sometimes win. {{weight}} In this lesson you write one for Café Aurora's website. {{cafe}} You decide what belongs in it: the scope, the facts it may use, the tone, the refusals. {{belongs}} And what never does. A secret in a system prompt is a secret one clever question away from the screen. {{secret}}
